title: Monthly Maintenance
description: Recurring monthly care routine for managed WordPress client sites.

steps.title: Verify Backups Ran Successfully
steps.instructions: Check backup plugin or host logs for the last 30 days. Confirm off-site copies exist and retention matches the SLA.

steps.title: Review Available Updates
steps.instructions: List core, plugin, and theme updates. Read changelogs and defer risky updates until tested on staging.

steps.title: Apply Tested Updates
steps.instructions: Update core and plugins on staging first, smoke-test key flows, then deploy to production during a low-traffic window.

steps.title: Review Uptime & Error Logs
steps.instructions: Check uptime monitor history and PHP/error logs for 500 errors, fatal errors, or spike in failed login attempts.

steps.title: Scan for Broken Links
steps.instructions: Run a broken-link scan on top landing pages and the sitemap. Fix 404s from recent content changes or redirects.

steps.title: Review Form Spam & Comments
steps.instructions: Clear spam comments and form entries. Verify CAPTCHA or honeypot still works after plugin updates.

steps.title: Send Client Maintenance Report
steps.instructions: Summarize updates applied, uptime, backup status, and any recommended follow-up work for the client.
